evidence_status: Independently authored source-only expectations; no evolving outputs generated and no imports, calculations, tests, builds or runtime checks executed.
use: Comparison only after the application independently produces results. Never a generator, importer, calculator, detector, scheduler or UI input.

cycle_contract.exhaustion: Index 1461 and higher raises ValueError; do not rewind or silently reuse an earlier cycle.
cycle_contract.source_selection: The new accepted run for each stable source replaces its previous selected batch; never union old selected batches or fall back to complete predecessors.
cycle_contract.identities: Every cycle has new source_run_id values for all nine envelopes; repeated calls with the same index and baseline inputs are deterministic. Later event episodes use later timestamps and distinct interval identities.
cycle_contract.input_roles: Exact rich-v1 policy plus eight default DHCP/routing observation envelopes only. No inventory, pack index, first-path, opt-in or expected-answer inputs.

current_occupancy.basis: Distinct active addresses at the selected demo clock, not interval count or monthly p95.
current_occupancy.repeat: After the reference, the same current-count phases recur every eight cycles with later event identities.
current_occupancy.renewal_control: The six-client cohort renews exactly at hour 12+48k without overlap or double-counting, then expires at hour 18+48k.
current_occupancy.history_limit: Do not copy current occupancy into p95 or forecast. These values must be calculated from the complete rolling history; historical pressure does not instantly clear on departure.

first_cycles.expect: Fresh complete evidence contains the current expected exact route.
Fresh complete evidence lacks the expected exact route after expiry at hour 24; missing_expected_route is supported.
The new selected batch is empty and declared incomplete. Route absence is unknown; do not resolve the earlier finding or use its complete predecessor.
Fresh complete evidence contains the exact route starting at hour 36; eligible recovery can resolve the missing-route finding.

scenarios.repeat: Route episodes are [36+48k,72+48k); subsequent gaps are [72+48k,84+48k). The North routing batch is incomplete at hour 30+48k, for k >= 0.

first_cycles.expect: Fresh complete evidence lacks the expected exact route; missing_expected_route is supported.
The exact route starts at hour 36 under fresh complete evidence; eligible recovery can resolve its missing-route finding.

scenarios.repeat: Contiguous intervals [36+48k,84+48k) preserve current presence from hour 36 onward; meeting boundaries are not withdrawals.

first_cycles.expect: The new address and route are not yet current.

Current address and route are inside managed space but outside intended inventory; eligible positive evidence adds observations to ghost_scope and unregistered_managed_route. Original Central anomalies already exist.

DHCP coverage age is 60 minutes and routing coverage age is 10 minutes. The selected views are stale; raw retained rows do not establish fresh current conclusions, and unknown cannot resolve prior findings.

Both sources are fresh again. The episode has ended at hour 48, so these new current observations disappear. The managed-perimeter findings remain anomalous because the original Central discrepancies still exist. Historical rows remain while they overlap the window.

scenarios.repeat: New discrepancy episodes are [36+48k,48+48k); stale views occur at hour 42+48k and contain only evidence available by their respective coverage cutoffs.

first_cycles.expect: The original concurrent claims are current and contribute one occupied address.
The original claims are no longer current and are never renewed, but their historical overlap remains eligible conflict evidence in the rolling window.
Two new incompatible principals simultaneously claim the new scoped address; the new conflict contributes one occupied address. Original historical conflict evidence remains.
The new claims expire at hour 54; historical conflict evidence is not instantly cleared by current expiry.

scenarios.repeat: New gamma/delta intervals are [48+48k,54+48k), for k >= 0. Historical evidence ages out only when it no longer overlaps the rolling 30-day window.

controls: Preserve scoped identity: matching North and Lab private addresses are legitimate isolated reuse.
Persistent baseline claims renew daily from their actual final expiry at hour 24; sequential renewals must not create occupancy spikes or incompatible-principal conflicts.
Complete source batches retain a full rolling 30-day history. Retain permitted future expiry times; do not emit future-start or future-observation rows beyond a view's cutoff.
Keep intended route policy separate from route observations. An explicit expected route needs an eligible complete view to support absence.
Keep the original rich-v1 inventory, source IDs and committed files unchanged; all changed envelope payloads receive new run identities.
Current lease expiry does not establish safe reclamation, and no synthetic scene represents live network discovery or external provisioning.

runtime_integration_requirements.ownership: Separate lead-assigned runtime adapter and scheduler; these are required integration behavior, not execution evidence from the pure recipe.
runtime_integration_requirements.advance: Manual next and configurable scheduling advance one index by six simulated hours; wall time does not replace the explicit demo clock.
runtime_integration_requirements.atomic_success: Commit all nine imports, the new demo clock, the saved calculation run and the persisted cursor together.
runtime_integration_requirements.failure: Roll back partial cycle effects visibly; retry the same index and payload identities without consuming the failed cycle.
runtime_integration_requirements.catch_up: At most one bounded catch-up cycle; no burst replay or clock rewind.
runtime_integration_requirements.packaging: Include ipam_synthetic_feed in the normal application wheel; the pure function performs no IO or application mutation.

verification_limits: All numeric values and transitions above are authored expectations. No executed record totals, generated byte hashes, receipts, findings or demonstrated questionnaire credit are supplied.
